def apply_fixes(table_name, issues, df):

                if removed > 0:

            print(f"✓ CLEANING COMPLETE AFTER {cycle-1} CYCLES!")
            print(f"✓ TOTAL FIXES APPLIED: {total_fixes}")
            print(f"{'='*80}")

                iqr = q3 - q1
                lower_bound = q1 - 1.5 * iqr

                if len(outliers) > 0:
